import pandas as pd
ben = pd.read_csv('beneficiaries.csv')
pay = pd.read_excel('payments.xlsx', skiprows=4)
# trim whitespace
pay['Beneficiary ID'] = pay['Beneficiary ID'].astype(str).str.strip()
pay['Status'] = pay['Status'].astype(str).str.strip()
# filter status Paid ignoring case
mask_status = pay['Status'].str.lower() == 'paid'
pay_filt = pay[mask_status].copy()
# exclude payment rows whose Beneficiary ID absent from CSV
ben_ids = set(ben['Beneficiary ID'].astype(str).str.strip())
pay_filt = pay_filt[pay_filt['Beneficiary ID'].isin(ben_ids)]
# merge
merged = pay_filt.merge(ben, on='Beneficiary ID', how='inner')
# filter donor and gender
merged = merged[merged['Donor'] == 'Azim Premji Foundation']
# gender case? CSV gender maybe 'Woman' exactly
# Trim whitespace?
merged['Gender'] = merged['Gender'].astype(str).str.strip()
result = merged[merged['Gender'].str.lower() == 'woman']
total = result['Amount (INR)'].sum()
print('rows', len(result))
print(result[['Beneficiary ID','Full Name','Gender','Amount (INR)','Donor']].head())
print('total', total)
\"
"

import pandas as pd, re
ben = pd.read_csv('beneficiaries.csv')
pay = pd.read_excel('payments.xlsx', skiprows=4)
pay['Beneficiary ID'] = pay['Beneficiary ID'].astype(str).str.strip()
pay['Status'] = pay['Status'].astype(str).str.strip()
mask_status = pay['Status'].str.lower() == 'paid'
pay_filt = pay[mask_status].copy()
ben_ids = set(ben['Beneficiary ID'].astype(str).str.strip())
pay_filt = pay_filt[pay_filt['Beneficiary ID'].isin(ben_ids)]
# clean amount
def clean_amt(x):
    if pd.isna(x): return None
    s=str(x)
    s=re.sub(r'["'^'"\\d]', '', s)
    return int(s) if s else None
pay_filt['Amount_clean'] = pay_filt['Amount (INR)'].apply(clean_amt)
merged = pay_filt.merge(ben, on='Beneficiary ID', how='inner')
merged = merged[merged['Donor']=='Azim Premji Foundation']
merged['Gender']=merged['Gender'].astype(str).str.strip()
result=merged[merged['Gender'].str.lower()=='woman']
total=result['Amount_clean'].sum()
print(total)
print(result[['Beneficiary ID','Full Name','Gender','Amount_clean']].head())
\"
"
